name: @vos/journal
description: Journal VOS — Journal + Habit PWA auf fuel-dev Shell (Firestore via fitness-aos)

scripts.build: VITE_APP_MODE=client vite build --config vite.config.cjs && node scripts/fix-vite-preload-markers.mjs dist-firebase
scripts.build:firebase: VITE_APP_MODE=client vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs && node scripts/fix-vite-preload-markers.mjs dist-firebase
scripts.build:cloud: VITE_APP_MODE=client vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs && node scripts/fix-vite-preload-markers.mjs dist-firebase
scripts.deploy:v2:root: VITE_APP_MODE=client VITE_DEFAULT_TAB=journal-v2 vite build --mode firebase --config vite.config.cjs --outDir dist-v2 && node scripts/fix-vite-preload-markers.mjs dist-v2
scripts.deploy:v2: pnpm run deploy:v2:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:v2 --project fitness-aos
scripts.deploy:door:build: node -e "console.log('door mini: pnpm run deploy:v2:build → dist-v2/mini/door')"
scripts.deploy:voice:build: node -e "console.log('voice mini: pnpm run deploy:v2:build → dist-v2/mini/voice')"
scripts.deploy:game:build: node -e "console.log('game mini: pnpm run deploy:v2:build → dist-v2/mini/game')"
scripts.deploy:tent:build: node -e "console.log('tent mini: pnpm run deploy:v2:build → dist-v2/mini/tent')"
scripts.deploy:habits:build: node -e "console.log('habits mini: pnpm run deploy:v2:build → dist-v2/mini/habits')"
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm run deploy:all:build && firebase deploy --only hosting:journal,hosting:v2,hosting:door,hosting:voice,hosting:game,hosting:tent,hosting:habits --project fitness-aos
scripts.tooling:check: pnpm run tooling:biome && pnpm run tooling:knip
